label: GB-equality-act-2010 Section 163

obligations.text:
Taxi licence conditional on compliance with taxi accessibility regulations
(1)
A licence for a taxi to ply for hire must not be granted unless the vehicle conforms with the provisions of taxi accessibility regulations with which a vehicle is required to conform if it is licensed.
